        LEFT JOIN (SELECT bank_id, payment_method, bucket, MAX(availability) AS availability, MAX(latency) AS latency
        FROM (SELECT bank_id, payment_method,

        AND bucket=date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes',bucket,TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01T00:00:00+05:30')) h ON p.payer_bank_id=h.bank_id
